owner_priority_lock.rule: Follow the explicit owner direction to pause technical_refactor and prioritize tour-search UX and user-facing visual work on AnyTour Design System 2.0.

current_stage.name: Site-wide DS2 visual convergence after selected-tour hardening
current_stage.last_material_progress: PR #636 fixed the confirmed 701–820px AnyTour Design System 2.0 gap in full-search advanced filters. At the required 768px width the rail now uses a dedicated two-column DS2 hierarchy with wrapping/min-width guards, stable flight toggles, hotel-service section and reset action instead of falling back to the older generic geometry. The bundle remains one CSS startup request while its strict manifest contract now tracks 35 CSS source inputs. All 21 PR checks passed, including the 375/430/768/1024/1440 visual suites. V2 production deploy passed Verify V2 and Live search smoke; standalone/public deploy passed public pages, unchanged lead bridge and Live search smoke. /hot/ and /how-to-buy/ were re-audited and no additional confirmed structural defect justified a speculative change.
current_stage.next_action: Continue the search/results-first path: visually inspect the results toolbar, hotel/tour cards and full-search filter lifecycle at 768/1024/1440 for confirmed DS2 wrapping, overflow or generation defects, while sampling /country/, /country/turkey/ and another representative country page at 375/430/768/1024/1440. Do not change /hot/ or /how-to-buy/ without a new confirmed defect.
